When a player registers with GamStop, they can choose to exclude themselves for six months, one year, or five years. During this time, they cannot access any UKGC-licensed gambling sites, providing a necessary tool for those seeking to manage their gambling habits.

However, the limitations of GamStop can lead players to explore non-GamStop casinos. These casinos operate under different jurisdictions, such as Curacao or Malta, and are not part of the GamStop system. Non-GamStop casinos provide a unique opportunity for players to enjoy a wider range of gaming options, higher staking limits, and often more generous bonuses, all without the restrictions imposed by GamStop.

Furthermore, non-GamStop sites offer players access to a variety of games, including slots, table games, and live dealer options. Players can enjoy a more flexible gaming experience, with fewer restrictions on bonus structures and game features. What to Watch Out For

While the bonuses at non-GamStop casinos can be enticing, players should be aware of certain factors:

  • Wagering Requirements: Bonuses often come with wagering requirements that dictate how many times players must bet the bonus amount before they can withdraw winnings. Common requirements range from x30 to x50.

  • Game Weighting: Not all games contribute equally towards meeting wagering requirements. Slots typically contribute 100%, while table games may contribute less.

  • Maximum Bet Rules: Some casinos impose restrictions on the maximum bet allowed when using bonus funds, which can affect how quickly players can meet wagering requirements.

  • Time Limits on Bonus Expiry: Bonuses often have an expiration date, meaning players must use them within a specific time frame or lose them.

  • Maximum Withdrawal Limits: Some bonuses come with limits on how much players can withdraw from their winnings.

  • Sticky vs Non-Sticky Bonuses: A sticky bonus means the bonus amount is deducted from the player's balance upon withdrawal, while a non-sticky bonus allows players to withdraw their own funds without losing the bonus.

Understanding these factors can help players make informed decisions when taking advantage of the bonuses available at non-GamStop casinos UK. It's advisable to read the terms and conditions carefully before claiming any offers.
